answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on open-ended text generation, as well as on general language modeling benchmarks, comparing various performance metrics with and without applying auto-contrastive decoding.

answer_2.quote: Generation quality is evaluated using automatic metrics focusing on different axes: aggregated ngram diversity measures the repetitiveness... semantic coherence estimates topic drift... We also report results of human evaluation... and use perplexity and accuracy on the LAMBADA benchmark.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation of a sample of generation outputs... 3 NLP experts labeled the 80 resulting instances... they were asked to select the better model on 3 different aspects: fluency, coherence and overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare two model outputs and choose which is better in terms of fluency, coherence, and overall quality (or indicate a tie).
